No. `amend` cannot set a missing `spec:` pointer; first assignment must use `new --spec`/`--brief` or `ready`. [bisellium-main/docs/ADOPTION.md:406-423]

It also treats `spec` values by their canonical resolved target, so alternate spellings or aliases such as `./briefs/x.md` are not changes when they identify the same document. The path must be officina-relative, resolve inside the officina, exist, and contain no symlinked component. [bisellium-main/docs/ADOPTION.md:414-423]

After changing a pointer away from the default, subsequent `ready` commands must explicitly pass `--spec`; otherwise `ready`’s default `briefs/<id>.md` silently reverts it. Re-pointing an active opus away from passed-gate evidence also requires the gate to be re-signed. [bisellium-main/docs/ADOPTION.md:425-435]
